decisions.notes: The rectangular window opening is cut all the way through a thick wall, with inset side panels. All orbit, edge, clay and wireframe views and the larger oblique render show a clean consistent module.
limitations: The opening has no glazing or window frame; this is a static, untextured wall module, not a finished building.
Simplified industrial kit; grid fit, interior traversal and collision have not been tested in-engine.

decisions.notes: The straight wall has two recessed panels and consistent thickness on both sides; eight orbit, top, underside, clay and wireframe views plus the large oblique render show a complete simple module.
limitations: This is a static, untextured modular wall and does not include openings.
Simplified industrial kit; grid fit, interior traversal and collision have not been tested in-engine.

decisions.notes: A square slab with four inset surface panels and visible edge thickness remains coherent from all orbit, top, bottom, clay and wireframe views; the large oblique view shows the panel joins clearly.
limitations: This untextured static slab requires a target-engine collision setup; its underside is plain.
Simplified industrial kit; grid fit, interior traversal and collision have not been tested in-engine.
